settings.heading: Find your fit
settings.text: Between two sizes? Pick the larger one for the true oversized street look.
settings.how_to:
Chest: the garment's chest all the way round, just below the armpits. Lay your favourite tee flat, measure armpit to armpit and double it to compare.
Length: from the highest point of the shoulder down to the hem.
Shoulder: seam to seam across the back.
Sleeve: from the shoulder seam to the sleeve hem.
Not sure? Use Find your size on any product page, or WhatsApp us your height and weight.
